prompts.phase-00: Create ONE complete whole-body 2D pixel-art fighting-game animation frame of the exact Zetton shown in the references, fixed side view facing right. Reference 1 is the actual low crouching guard that this frame must continue; reference 2 is identity only and MUST NOT change the pose to standing. Keep the pelvis as low as reference 1, the rear leg deeply folded close to the ground and the front knee bent, with BOTH feet at the same contact positions. Preserve body scale, head size, ground baseline, black alien body, pale segmented arms and thighs, two distinct curved antennae, the narrow vertical orange face light and paired orange chest organs. Both complete arms, hands, legs, feet and antenna tips must remain attached and fully inside the canvas. Keep near/far limbs distinct; no added limbs, human facial features, weapons or armor. Do not stand up, widen the stance, straighten the knees, enlarge the head, compress the entire sprite, or replace the character with a translated copy. Sharp coherent pixel art, isolated genuine transparent background with margins. No opponent, ground, shadow, text, sparks, beams, trails or effects. This is the FIRST moment of low crouching block stun after an incoming attack from the right. The bent forearms brace together in front of the low upper body; the shoulders and torso recoil a SMALL amount backward while the hips stay low and the bent knees and planted feet do not change support. The head remains near its original crouching height, not the higher standing guard. Make a new complete reaction pose, not the unchanged reference guard.

Show a distinct but small recovery change, not a standing guard and not a duplicate static frame. The next pose will be the original low crouching guard.
